notes: 1979 light warm grey board-sided condo, stepped Hyde frontage over edges 1 and 2 (collinear), flat roof with no cornice, large dark-framed windows in pairs, recessed entry among hedges and a low brick plinth. Darkened to the mid warm grey of the readable adjoining planes. The punched double-hung grid is gone. Light-to-mid grey board siding; the long Hyde plane is a banded frame of large dark-framed window walls with darker grey floor bands, two recessed steel-railed balconies and interior shutters/blinds behind the glass. The short front plane carries a glazed projecting box bay over the recessed entry. The side plane gets wide picture windows. Pink base removed: a low brick planter band and a dark garage in the podium. Siding and floor bands cooled to neutral light/mid grey, garage moved between two frame posts, brick planter band deeper. Brick planter band deep red-brown and raised to planter height; floor bands project less. Taupe warm-grey board siding, the concrete slab and pilaster grid on the long plane is gone for an irregular rhythm of narrow tall single windows and wider two-light windows in thin dark frames (interior shutters behind); the glass canted bay on the short front becomes a flat projecting box face with one window per floor and a small steel-railed balcony on the second upper storey; ground: low brick planters, a recessed dark entry and short garden-level windows (no roll-up garage, no blank infills, no pink band); lower plates leave room for a set-back dark-glazed penthouse block. The front box frame is kept to the short front only; the long and side planes are plain siding with punched windows. Rework B: warm grey-taupe siding (neutral tint on the stained base), terracotta base band removed. The long Hyde plane is one wall-coloured frame (thin seams only) holding an irregular pattern: narrow recessed slit windows and wide 2-3 lite dark-framed windows with pale shutter backing grouped per bay, different on each storey, a small bar-railed balcony with a projecting deck in the right-hand wide bay at storey 3, and a continuous ribbon on the top storey. The narrow front return (edge 1) loses its slab/balcony stack for one wide window per storey. Not doable: real projecting/recessed bays and a setback top storey (no key moves wall planes), brick forecourt and hedges. Rework 2: siding tint set so the game draws a mid warm-cool grey (~#7a7873; the old #5c5c5c on the wood-siding kit drew near-black in game); tan louvred blinds (#c9b27a) drawn behind the glazing at up to full height, visible in sv3; the storey-3 balcony slab lip deepened to 1.0 m so it projects past the wall (a recess under 0.6 m drops the balcony in the kit). Not doable: a set-back top storey (no key), diagonal steel brackets under the balcony, the recessed dark ground storey and planters. Top-storey continuous ribbon broken into the bay rhythm of the storey below, second slab balcony stacked on storey 2, siding a step lighter. Set-back planted forecourt not drawable. Siding stepped darker/cooler toward the grey the readable edge shows (#c2c4cb -> #aeb0b8); slab bands and balconies already present each floor; shutters, brick planters and hedge forecourt not drawable/hidden by blur. Clapboard fix (2026-10-02): painted siding moved from the stained-timber wood-siding base to painted-clapboard so the tint renders as paint, not olive. Tint lift (2026-10-02): wall tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k).
